backtest_hint_total_return: Period PnL ÷ initial capital. Under the shared pool the denominator is the account's single initial capital, so per-symbol returns sum to the account total return
backtest_hint_cagr: Compounded annualization over the data range: (1 + total return)^(365 / backtest days) − 1. Inflated when the span is under a year; use this metric for cross-period comparison
backtest_hint_sharpe_ratio: Risk-adjusted return: annualized return ÷ annualized volatility; higher means more return per unit of risk. Account-level, not splittable per symbol under a shared pool
backtest_hint_deflated_sharpe: Luck-adjusted Sharpe credibility (0~1, higher is more credible): the equity curve is split into calendar-year segments, each segment's return Sharpe forms the trial distribution, and the kernel DSR algorithm then evaluates whether the overall Sharpe significantly beats chance. '—' means fewer than two valid year segments or kernel unavailable
backtest_hint_pbo: Backtest overfitting probability (CSCV method, 0~1, lower is better): each symbol's return series is split into combinatorially symmetric cross-validation blocks, counting how often the in-sample winner falls behind out-of-sample; >0.5 suggests the edge between strategies is largely luck. No cross-strategy comparison exists for single-symbol backtests or a shared equity pool, shown as '—'
backtest_hint_max_drawdown: Largest peak-to-trough decline of equity, measuring worst-case loss depth. Account-level, not splittable per symbol under a shared pool
backtest_hint_win_rate: Winning fills ÷ total fills. Note the denominator counts engine fills (both opens and closes)
backtest_hint_profit_factor: Gross profit of winning trades ÷ absolute gross loss of losing trades. Above 1 means net profit; 1 means break-even
backtest_hint_total_trades: Engine fill count (opens and closes each count once). Differs from the round-trip scope of "winning + losing trades", which counts one complete open-close cycle as one
backtest_hint_winning_trades: Round-trip trades closed with positive PnL
backtest_hint_losing_trades: Round-trip trades closed with zero or negative PnL
backtest_hint_total_pnl: Sum of realized PnL (commission deducted). Under the shared pool, each symbol's value is its contribution to account PnL
backtest_hint_initial_equity: Starting capital of the backtest. Under the shared pool it is the account's single initial capital, not multiplied by symbol count
backtest_hint_final_equity: Account equity at backtest end, including floating PnL of open positions
backtest_hint_equity_peak: Highest account equity reached during the backtest; max drawdown is measured against it
backtest_hint_calmar_ratio: Annualized return ÷ max drawdown, return earned per unit of drawdown. Portfolio view = account return / account drawdown; not applicable in shared-pool symbol view (numerator and denominator are different levels)
backtest_hint_avg_drawdown: Average of pointwise drawdowns from running peak along the equity curve, reflecting typical drawdown (max drawdown only sees the deepest). Account-level, not splittable per symbol under a shared pool
backtest_hint_volatility: Std-dev of per-bar log returns × √(bars per year), measuring equity volatility; higher means riskier. Account-level, not splittable per symbol under a shared pool
backtest_hint_expectancy: Total PnL ÷ fill count, i.e. average PnL per fill; positive implies positive long-run expectancy
backtest_hint_avg_trade: Arithmetic mean of per-trade returns, the average profit level of a single trade
backtest_hint_best_trade: Highest single-trade return among all trades
backtest_hint_worst_trade: Lowest single-trade return among all trades, useful for gauging per-trade risk exposure
backtest_hint_total_commission: Cumulative trading commissions during the backtest, already deducted from PnL
backtest_hint_sqn: System Quality Number = √trades × mean per-trade return ÷ std-dev, a combined measure of strategy stability and repeatability
backtest_hint_kelly_criterion: Suggested position fraction f = win rate − (1 − win rate) ÷ payoff ratio; negative values are floored at 0 (do not bet)
backtest_hint_exposure_time: Union of holding intervals ÷ total backtest duration, the share of time capital is in the market (overlapping positions not double-counted)
backtest_hint_duration_days: Calendar days covered by backtest data, the basis for annualized metrics. Account-level constant, identical for all symbols
backtest_hint_avg_trade_duration_hours: Average hours from entry to exit per trade, reflecting the strategy's holding cycle
backtest_hint_max_trade_duration_hours: Longest hours from entry to exit in a single trade, useful for spotting abnormally long open positions
